prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in League City, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1150; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use my claim reference.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was stopped at a red light on the main road in League City, near the shopping center entrance. Traffic had been backing up for a few minutes.

Q: What happened next?

A: The car behind me didn't stop. I felt a hard jolt from behind and my head snapped forward and then back against the headrest. My car rolled a little into the intersection before the brakes caught.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, and the airbags did not deploy. I got out and walked around for a minute, but I didn't feel right.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that afternoon. They told me I have a concussion. I've had headaches, and bright lights bother me. I also get dizzy when I stand up too quickly.

Q: Have you missed any work because of this?

A: Yes, I've been off since the accident. My doctor said I need to limit screen time and rest for now.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Just that the other driver admitted at the scene that they were looking at their phone. I'd like this documented.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you in writing.

A: Thank you.
